verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents a generic event export API (amplitude-docs-12, amplitude-docs-30) letting you pull event/dashboard data out of the platform, but there is no evidence of dedicated warehouse-sync features (e.g., continuous export to Snowflake/BigQuery/Redshift) or of querying warehouse tables directly inside Amplitude. Missing for 10: documented warehouse destination/continuous sync connectors, in-product warehouse query capability, and any independent confirmation of warehouse integration reliability.
